arrays.instance_ids: Native semseg group.id / .house O ID; -1 is unassigned or no mesh hit.
arrays.depths: Fresh raycast axial depth in metres; NaN for no hit; annotation only.
arrays.camera_to_world: Freshly read native undistorted .conf camera transforms.
arrays.image_names: Original RGB image names in array-index order.

mapping: Mesh face -> fsegs segment -> semseg group.id -> .house O category_id -> .house C mpcat40; O region_id -> R region.
context_caveat: Region context mapping is assistant-screened and is not pixel-level human GT.
native_instance_caveat: A native door-labeled instance can include frame, wall or other geometry; pixel counts do not certify isolated door-leaf visibility.
